title: Ambrose Lofts - 1 BR overlooking 4th Ave Downtown
description:
A stone’s throw from the Ryman Auditorium,a short walk to Broadway & Printer’s Alley.  

Just renovated Historic Ambrose Loft in a former printing company building built in 1905.
14’ ceilings, exposed beams, Carrera marble  shower & handshower, custom waterfall marble vanity with copper sink & Brizo fixtures.

Loft overlooks 4th Avenue, includes 70” TV in living room & 65” TV in the bedroom.  Curated record collection with some of my favorites. Parlor guitar.

No parking. Pay garage next door.
